sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Flappy Plane are simple yet addictive. You control your plane using your choice of mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, jumping over obstacles to collect coins and increase your score. The game is divided into levels, with each level becoming increasingly difficult as you progress. As you jump over obstacles, you'll need to time your jumps perfectly to avoid crashing and losing a life. The game also features a coin system, where you can collect coins to unlock power-ups and bonuses.

One of the key features of Flappy Plane is its precision controls. The game is designed to be played with precision timing, requiring you to time your jumps perfectly to avoid obstacles.
